answer: Each new identity must lock 1,500 POA for three full epochs before any answer can draw from the emission pool. Five established attestors, assigned by hashing this epoch's seed with the applicant's address, have to countersign a uniqueness receipt; if two keys share a funding parent, both bonds are burned to the pool. Withdrawal stays blocked until two quiet epochs pass after the last payout, so a river of clones cannot cash out inside the fraud window. That jade cost is the rule itself, and a vine of reused wallets is cut at the first collision of funding proofs.
